road_topology.name: Road network topology
road_topology.description: Graph structure, edge lengths, road classifications.

signal_placement.name: Traffic signal locations
signal_placement.description: Signal placement at intersections above a degree threshold.
limitations: Not verified against Bengaluru BTMC signal inventory
Number and location are assumed, not observed

signal_timing.name: Signal phase timing
signal_timing.description: Neither calibrated from Bengaluru timing plans nor validated.
limitations: Bengaluru uses SCATS adaptive control at some junctions

demand_matrix.name: Travel demand (OD matrix)
demand_matrix.source: Boundary-anchor generation with random vehicle mix
demand_matrix.description: Synthetic directional demand; no observed Bengaluru OD matrix used.

vehicle_behaviour.name: Car following and lane change parameters
vehicle_behaviour.source: SUMO Krauss model with default parameters
vehicle_behaviour.description: Standard SUMO parameters; not calibrated to Bengaluru driving.
limitations: Indian driving behavior differs substantially from defaults

ioc_survey.name: IOC Junction vehicle counts
ioc_survey.source: B-SMILE project report via OpenCity; count date 24 Aug 2021
ioc_survey.description: Classified vehicle counts at one corridor, 06:00-20:00.
limitations: Four interval totals printed as zero despite positive counts
Not used to fit the SUMO experiment

background_traffic.name: Background traffic fraction
background_traffic.source: Planner assumes 15%; SUMO has zero background vehicles
background_traffic.description: Explicit mismatch between forecast model and execution.

calibration_targets.name: Background traffic fraction
calibration_targets.required_evidence: Observed link flows or OD survey to estimate non-modeled vehicles
calibration_targets.target_metric: Background fraction within 5% of observed saturation gap
calibration_targets.notes: Now defaults to 0.0 in code; set >0 only with evidence

calibration_targets.name: Signal timing parameters
calibration_targets.required_evidence: Bengaluru BTMC signal timing plans or field-measured phase splits
calibration_targets.target_metric: Green time within 10% of observed at calibrated junctions

calibration_targets.name: Car-following behaviour
calibration_targets.required_evidence: Trajectory data or queue discharge rate measurements
calibration_targets.target_metric: Queue discharge headway within 0.5s of observed mean

calibration_targets.name: Demand pattern
calibration_targets.required_evidence: OD survey, ATCC data, or Bluetooth/Wi-Fi re-identification

calibration_targets.name: Link travel time
calibration_targets.required_evidence: Probe vehicle data, Google/TomTom API, or floating car surveys

calibration_targets.name: ETA prediction (Bengaluru)
calibration_targets.required_evidence: Bengaluru trip time observations for training and held-out testing
calibration_targets.target_metric: 10% relative MAE improvement over strong baselines on Bengaluru data
calibration_targets.notes: Chengdu MAE is not transferable; Bengaluru claims require Bengaluru validation
